hook: Jitendra Malik was born in 1960 and earned his undergraduate degree at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur before completing his PhD at Stanford University. He joined the faculty of the University of California, Berkeley, where he became the Arthur J. Chick Professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences. With his student Jianbo Shi, he developed the normalized cuts algorithm, a graph based method for image segmentation published in 2000 that treated grouping pixels into regions as a graph partitioning problem and became one of the most cited techniques in computer vision. His research group's later work, including the region proposal based R-CNN approach to object detection developed with his students, helped connect classical computer vision with the deep learning era. Over his career at Berkeley he has supervised more than 40 PhD students and numerous postdoctoral researchers who have gone on to research and leadership roles at companies and universities including Google, Meta, MIT and Carnegie Mellon.
name: Jitendra Malik
moniker: Pioneer of computer vision and image segmentation

primary.name: Normalized Cuts and Image Segmentation, IEEE TPAMI

timeline.event: Publishes Normalized Cuts and Image Segmentation with Jianbo Shi
timeline.impact: Introduced a graph theoretic approach to image segmentation that became a standard technique and a heavily cited foundation for later segmentation methods.

timeline.event: Co-authors Rich Feature Hierarchies for Accurate Object Detection and Semantic Segmentation, the R-CNN paper, with his students
timeline.impact: Helped launch the modern era of deep learning based object detection by combining region proposals with convolutional neural network features.

achievements.title: Co-developed normalized cuts for image segmentation
achievements.impact: Reframing image segmentation as a graph partitioning problem gave the field a principled, widely adopted method for grouping pixels into coherent regions.

achievements.title: Helped connect classical and deep learning based computer vision
achievements.impact: Research from his group on region proposals and learned visual features contributed to the lineage of methods, including R-CNN, that brought deep learning into object detection.

achievements.title: Trained a generation of computer vision researchers
achievements.impact: His more than 40 PhD students and many postdoctoral researchers went on to shape computer vision research and practice at major universities and technology companies.
